evidence.title: Evaluation of TU-100 (Daikenchuto), a Traditional Japanese Kampo Medicine, as an Adjunct to Enhanced Recovery After Surgery, for Acceleration of Gastrointestinal Recovery After Bowel Resection: Results of a Proof-of-Concept, Phase 2, Randomized, Double-Blinded, Placebo-Controlled Trial.
evidence.venue: Diseases of the colon and rectum
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: TU-100 7.5 g/d was not associated with a statistically significant difference for GI recovery (HR 1.17 [95% CI, 0.91-1.50]).
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: A transient inhibition of GI motility (postoperative ileus) can occur after colorectal surgery and may lead to complications and prolonged hospitalization.
evidence.key_finding: TU-100 7.5 g/d was not associated with a statistically significant difference for GI recovery (HR 1.17 [95% CI, 0.91-1.50]).

evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Clinical Trial, Phase II|Randomized Controlled Trial|Multicenter Study
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: A transient inhibition of GI motility (postoperative ileus) can occur after colorectal surgery and may lead to complications and prolonged hospitalization. | INTERVENTIONS: Placebo, TU-100 7.5 g/d, or TU-100 15 g/d given orally from postoperative day 1 for 10 days or less while hospitalized. | However, a higher proportion of patients in the 7.5 g/d group achieved GI recovery by postoperative day 2 versus the placebo group (78.1% vs 66.9%, p = 0.047).

evidence.title: Effect of Perioperative Supplementation with Arginine and Omega-3 on Postoperative Complications in Patients Undergoing Gastrointestinal Cancer Surgery: A Pilot Open-Label Randomized Controlled Trial.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSIONS: In this trial, perioperative immunonutrition with arginine and omega-3 fatty acids did not improve postoperative clinical outcomes or inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery.
evidence.outcome: AIM: To evaluate the effects of perioperative arginine and omega-3 supplementation on postoperative infectious complications, mortality, hospital length of stay, intensive care unit duration, and inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery. | Primary endpoints were postoperative infectious complications and 1-month mortality. | RESULTS: No statistically significant differences were observed between groups in 1-month mortality (p = 0.324), hospital length of stay (median 7 vs. 7 days, p = 0.392), or ICU duration (median 5 vs. 6 days, p = 0.601).
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: In this trial, perioperative immunonutrition with arginine and omega-3 fatty acids did not improve postoperative clinical outcomes or inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 이 시험에서 아르기닌과 오메가-3 지방산을 포함한 수술 전후 면역영양은 위장관암 수술 환자의 수술 후 임상결과나 염증표지자를 개선하지 못했다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Perioperative immunonutrition, including arginine and omega-3 fatty acids, has been proposed to support postoperative recovery by modulating immune function. | AIM: To evaluate the effects of perioperative arginine and omega-3 supplementation on postoperative infectious complications, mortality, hospital length of stay, intensive care unit duration, and inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery. | METHODS: In this Pilot Open-Label randomized trial, 35 adult patients scheduled for elective gastrointestinal cancer surgery at Salah Azaiez Institute were randomly assigned to receive either perioperative immunonutrition (n = 18; three daily capsules of omega-3 and one sachet of Arginine+ for 7 days preoperatively and 7 days postoperatively) or standard care (n = 17).

all_evidence.title: A systematic review of the cost and cost effectiveness of using standard oral nutritional supplements in the hospital setting.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: Cost savings were typically associated with significantly improved outcomes, demonstrated through the following meta-analyses: reduced mortality (Risk ratio 0.650, P < 0.05; N = 5 studies), reduced complications (by 35% of the total; P < 0.001, N = 7 studies) and reduced length of hospital stay (by ∼2 days, P < 0.05; N = 5 surgical studies) corresponding to ∼13.0% reduction in hospital stay.
all_evidence.outcome: Cost savings were typically associated with significantly improved outcomes, demonstrated through the following meta-analyses: reduced mortality (Risk ratio 0.650, P < 0.05; N = 5 studies), reduced complications (by 35% of the total; P < 0.001, N = 7 studies) and reduced length of hospital stay (by ∼2 days, P < 0.05; N = 5 surgical studies) corresponding to ∼13.0% reduction in hospital stay.
all_evidence.key_finding: Cost savings were typically associated with significantly improved outcomes, demonstrated through the following meta-analyses: reduced mortality (Risk ratio 0.650, P < 0.05; N = 5 studies), reduced complications (by 35% of the total; P < 0.001, N = 7 studies) and reduced length of hospital stay (by ∼2 days, P < 0.05; N = 5 surgical studies) corresponding to ∼13.0% reduction in hospital stay.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 비용 절감은 대체로 유의하게 개선된 결과와 연관됐으며, 메타분석에서 사망률 감소(RR 0.650, P<0.05; 5개 연구), 합병증 35% 감소(P<0.001; 7개 연구), 입원 기간 약 2일 감소(P<0.05; 수술 연구 5개, 입원 기간 약 13% 감소)를 보였습니다.
all_evidence.population: METHODS: A systematic literature search of multiple databases, data synthesis and analysis were undertaken according to recommended procedures. | The sample sizes of patients with surgical, orthopaedic and medical problems and combinations of these varied from 40 to 1.16 million. | In a meta-analysis of five abdominal surgical studies in the UK, the mean net cost saving was £746 per patient (se £338; P = 0.027).

all_evidence.title: Efficacy and Safety of SmofKabiven® Versus Hospital-Compounded All-in-One Parenteral Nutrition in Chinese Patients Undergoing Gastrointestinal Surgery: A Multicenter, Randomized, Active-Controlled, Phase III Trial.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: SmofKabiven® was comparable to hospital-compounded PN in improving postoperative nutritional status and safety profile and its enrichment with omega-3 fatty acids and taurine may provide additional benefits.
all_evidence.outcome: Treatment-related adverse events were comparable in the two groups.
all_evidence.key_finding: SmofKabiven® was comparable to hospital-compounded PN in improving postoperative nutritional status and safety profile and its enrichment with omega-3 fatty acids and taurine may provide additional benefits.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: SmofKabiven®은 수술 후 영양상태 개선과 안전성에서 병원 조제 정맥영양과 비슷했으며, 오메가-3 지방산과 타우린 강화가 추가 이점을 제공할 수 있다.
all_evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial, Phase III|Equivalence Trial|Journal Article|Multicenter Study|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
all_evidence.population: This multicenter, randomized, non-inferiority phase III trial (NCT03792100) aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of SmofKabiven®, a three-chamber parenteral nutrition (PN) emulsion in adult patients undergoing gastrointestinal surgery. | Eligible participants were randomized to either SmofKabiven® group (SEG) (n = 135) or hospital-compounded PN group (HCG) (n = 134) for five consecutive postoperative days. | SmofKabiven® was comparable to hospital-compounded PN in improving postoperative nutritional status and safety profile and its enrichment with omega-3 fatty acids and taurine may provide additional benefits.

all_evidence.title: Chinese herbal medicine (JianPi-BuShen) and completion rate of adjuvant chemotherapy for patients with stage II and III colon cancer: A randomized clinical trial.

all_evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Multicenter Study|Clinical Trial, Phase III
all_evidence.population: PATIENTS AND METHODS: This multi-center, phase III, randomized, placebo-controlled trial included patients with stage II (high risk for recurrence) and stage III colon cancer following surgery, planning to receive CAPOX (capecitabine and oxaliplatin) chemotherapy.

all_evidence.title: Quality of life after hip fracture in the elderly: A systematic literature review.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_14: Supportive psychotherapy in "low-functioning" patients, (home) rehabilitation programmes and nutritional supplementation appeared to have beneficial effects on HS.
all_evidence.outcome: Mental state, prefracture functioning on physical and psychosocial domains, comorbidity, female gender, nutritional status, postoperative pain, length of hospital stay, and complications were factors associated with HS or HRQOL.
all_evidence.key_finding: Supportive psychotherapy in "low-functioning" patients, (home) rehabilitation programmes and nutritional supplementation appeared to have beneficial effects on HS.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 저기능 환자에서 지지적 심리치료, 가정 재활 프로그램, 영양 보충은 건강상태에 유익한 효과를 보였다.
all_evidence.population: Mental state, prefracture functioning on physical and psychosocial domains, comorbidity, female gender, nutritional status, postoperative pain, length of hospital stay, and complications were factors associated with HS or HRQOL. | CONCLUSIONS: Optimizing nutrition intake, (home) rehabilitation programmes, and the possibility for psychological counselling in patients with difficulties in the psychosocial dimensions would be recommended after hip fracture surgery. | Besides HS questionnaires like EQ-5D and SF-36, adequate measurements like the WHOQOL-Bref or ICECAP-O are warranted in future studies regarding hip fracture surgery and postoperative treatment options.

evidence.title: Effect of Perioperative Supplementation with Arginine and Omega-3 on Postoperative Complications in Patients Undergoing Gastrointestinal Cancer Surgery: A Pilot Open-Label Randomized Controlled Trial.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSIONS: In this trial, perioperative immunonutrition with arginine and omega-3 fatty acids did not improve postoperative clinical outcomes or inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery.
evidence.outcome: AIM: To evaluate the effects of perioperative arginine and omega-3 supplementation on postoperative infectious complications, mortality, hospital length of stay, intensive care unit duration, and inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery. | Primary endpoints were postoperative infectious complications and 1-month mortality. | RESULTS: No statistically significant differences were observed between groups in 1-month mortality (p = 0.324), hospital length of stay (median 7 vs. 7 days, p = 0.392), or ICU duration (median 5 vs. 6 days, p = 0.601).
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: In this trial, perioperative immunonutrition with arginine and omega-3 fatty acids did not improve postoperative clinical outcomes or inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 이 시험에서 아르기닌과 오메가-3 지방산을 포함한 수술 전후 면역영양은 위장관암 수술 환자의 수술 후 임상결과나 염증표지자를 개선하지 못했다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Perioperative immunonutrition, including arginine and omega-3 fatty acids, has been proposed to support postoperative recovery by modulating immune function. | AIM: To evaluate the effects of perioperative arginine and omega-3 supplementation on postoperative infectious complications, mortality, hospital length of stay, intensive care unit duration, and inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery. | METHODS: In this Pilot Open-Label randomized trial, 35 adult patients scheduled for elective gastrointestinal cancer surgery at Salah Azaiez Institute were randomly assigned to receive either perioperative immunonutrition (n = 18; three daily capsules of omega-3 and one sachet of Arginine+ for 7 days preoperatively and 7 days postoperatively) or standard care (n = 17).

evidence.title: Physical and Nutritional Prehabilitation in Older Patients With Colorectal Carcinoma: A Systematic Review.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: CONCLUSIONS: Physical and nutritional prehabilitation in older patients with CRC has not shown a significant reduction in postoperative complications or length of stay.
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Sarcopenia and malnourishment are highly prevalent in older patients with colorectal cancer (CRC), who form a growing group of patients at risk of adverse outcome after surgery. | Intervention on physical function and/or nutritional status may decrease the risk of postoperative complications. | None of the preoperative interventions significantly reduced length of stay, mortality, or readmission rates.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: Physical and nutritional prehabilitation in older patients with CRC has not shown a significant reduction in postoperative complications or length of stay.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 고령 대장암 환자가 수술 전에 운동과 영양 준비를 했을 때 수술 후 합병증이나 입원 기간이 뚜렷하게 줄지는 않았습니다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Sarcopenia and malnourishment are highly prevalent in older patients with colorectal cancer (CRC), who form a growing group of patients at risk of adverse outcome after surgery. | Intervention on physical function and/or nutritional status may decrease the risk of postoperative complications. | However, the overall effect of preoperative physical and nutritional interventions (better known as prehabilitation) in older patients with CRC remains unknown.

evidence.title: Chinese herbal medicine (Tangshen Formula) formula treatment of patients with diabetic kidney disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: The results indicate that, compared to the sole conventional placebo treatment, the use of TSF treatment after 24 weeks shows significant improvement in the experimental group over the control group, with UAER (MD=-15.94(95% CI: -30.67-1.22); P=0.03) and 24h UP (MD=-0.20(95% CI:-0.36-0.05);P=0.01); assessment of eGFR and scores showed no significant changes in the levels of these two indicators in patients, e GFR (MD=-4.95(95% CI: -11.52-1.62); P=0.47) and scores (MD=0.35(95% CI: -1.29-1.98);P=0.92).
evidence.outcome: The main outcome indicators included renal Primary Outcomes(UAER, 24h UP), Secondary Outcomes(eGFR and TCM system scores) and adverse events. | In the TMC compound therapy for DKD patients with massive proteinuria, the results show that the probability of adverse experiments in the intervention group was significantly lower than that in the control group (OR= 0.55 95% CI 0.30-1.03), P=0.79).
evidence.key_finding: The results indicate that, compared to the sole conventional placebo treatment, the use of TSF treatment after 24 weeks shows significant improvement in the experimental group over the control group, with UAER (MD=-15.94(95% CI: -30.67-1.22); P=0.03) and 24h UP (MD=-0.20(95% CI:-0.36-0.05);P=0.01); assessment of eGFR and scores showed no significant changes in the levels of these two indicators in patients, e GFR (MD=-4.95(95% CI: -11.52-1.62); P=0.47) and scores (MD=0.35(95% CI: -1.29-1.98);P=0.92).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 24주 후 TSF군은 대조군보다 UAER와 24시간 요단백에서 유의한 개선을 보였지만, eGFR과 점수에는 유의한 변화가 없었다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVE: Diabetic Kidney Disease (DKD) is a severe complication of diabetes mellitus and is one of the main causes of end-stage renal disease globally. | The main outcome indicators included renal Primary Outcomes(UAER, 24h UP), Secondary Outcomes(eGFR and TCM system scores) and adverse events.

evidence.title: Meta-analysis of Niaoduqing Granules for uremic pruritus in Chinese hemodialysis patients: efficacy and safety evidence from RCTs.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: This meta-analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy favoring the Niaoduqing Granule group (RR = 1.249; 95% CIs = 1.169-1.335; p < 0.001), with safety analyses across three trials revealing comparable adverse event rates (R = 1.303; 95% CIs = 0.589-2.884; p = 0.514; I 2 = 0.0%).
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Uremic pruritus, a common complication in hemodialysis populations, adversely affects quality of life owing to multifactorial etiology. | This meta-analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy favoring the Niaoduqing Granule group (RR = 1.249; 95% CIs = 1.169-1.335; p < 0.001), with safety analyses across three trials revealing comparable adverse event rates (R = 1.303; 95% CIs = 0.589-2.884; p = 0.514; I 2 = 0.0%). | CONCLUSION: Niaoduqing Granules demonstrated efficacy in reducing pruritus severity among hemodialysis patients without increasing drug-related adverse events, while also showing concomitant reductions in inflammatory biomarkers.
evidence.key_finding: This meta-analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy favoring the Niaoduqing Granule group (RR = 1.249; 95% CIs = 1.169-1.335; p < 0.001), with safety analyses across three trials revealing comparable adverse event rates (R = 1.303; 95% CIs = 0.589-2.884; p = 0.514; I 2 = 0.0%).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 이 메타분석에서는 니아오두칭 과립군의 임상적으로 의미 있는 효과가 우세했습니다(RR=1.249, 95% CI 1.169~1.335, p<0.001). 3개 시험의 안전성 분석에서는 이상반응률이 비슷했습니다(R=1.303, 95% CI 0.589~2.884, p=0.514; I²=0.0%).
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Uremic pruritus, a common complication in hemodialysis populations, adversely affects quality of life owing to multifactorial etiology. | To assess its therapeutic potential, a retrospective meta-analysis was performed to evaluate efficacy and safety profiles in hemodialysis cohorts. | We systematically reviewed all available randomized controlled trials (RCTs) investigating the effects of Niaoduqing Granules on uremic pruritus in hemodialysis populations.

evidence.title: Vitamin Profile of the Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease Receiving a Novel Total Parenteral Nutrition Formula: Multicenter Randomized Controlled Phase III Trial.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: RESULTS: Values of blood protein until day 8 were similar in 2 groups although those of vitamins B1, B6, C, and folic acid (contained more in OPF-109) were higher in the OPF-109 group.
evidence.outcome: Safety endpoints were hematological data, blood biochemistry data, vital signs, and adverse events.
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: Values of blood protein until day 8 were similar in 2 groups although those of vitamins B1, B6, C, and folic acid (contained more in OPF-109) were higher in the OPF-109 group.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과: 8일까지 혈중 단백질 수치는 두 군이 비슷했지만, 비타민 B1·B6·C와 엽산 수치는 OPF-109군에서 더 높았다.
evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Clinical Trial, Phase III|Multicenter Study|Randomized Controlled Trial
evidence.population:
UNLABELLED:

Introduction: Efficacy and safety of a novel total parenteral nutrition formula for chronic kidney disease patients, OPF-109, containing multivitamins based on the FDA2000 recommendation were investigated. | METHODS: We conducted a phase III clinical trial administering OPF-109 (n = 63) or the control solutions (combination of marketed products including multivitamin based on American Medical Association 1975 guidelines) (n = 61) to the chronic kidney disease patients for 8 days. | CONCLUSION: Efficacy and safety of OPF-109 and usefulness of multivitamins based on the FDA2000 recommendation formula were confirmed in chronic kidney disease patients.

all_evidence.title: Ferric pyrophosphate citrate (Triferic™) administration via the dialysate maintains hemoglobin and iron balance in chronic hemodialysis patients.
all_evidence.venue: Nephrology, dialysis, transplantation : official publication of the European Dialysis and Transplant Association - European Renal Association
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: RESULTS: In both trials, Hgb concentration was maintained from baseline to EoT in the FPC group but decreased by 0.4 g/dL in the placebo group (P < 0.001, combined results; 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.2-0.6).
all_evidence.outcome: The proportions of patients with adverse and serious adverse events were similar in both treatment groups.
all_evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: In both trials, Hgb concentration was maintained from baseline to EoT in the FPC group but decreased by 0.4 g/dL in the placebo group (P < 0.001, combined results; 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.2-0.6).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 두 연구 모두 FPC군의 Hgb 농도는 기저치부터 연구 종료 시점까지 유지됐지만 위약군에서는 0.4 g/dL 감소했습니다(P<0.001; 통합 결과 95% 신뢰구간 0.2~0.6).
all_evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial, Phase III|Journal Article|Multicenter Study|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Administration of ferric pyrophosphate citrate (FPC, Triferic™) via hemodialysate may allow replacement of ongoing uremic and hemodialysis-related iron losses. | METHODS: Two identical Phase 3, randomized, placebo-controlled trials (CRUISE 1 and 2) were conducted in 599 iron-replete chronic hemodialysis patients. | CONCLUSIONS: FPC delivered via dialysate during hemodialysis replaces iron losses, maintains Hgb concentrations, does not increase iron stores and exhibits a safety profile similar to placebo.

all_evidence.title: The role of nutritional vitamin D on microinflammation and nutritional status in maintenance hemodialysis patients: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_15: CONCLUSION: Nutritional vitamin D supplementation may improve microinflammation and nutritional status in MHD patients, with potential benefits for bone metabolism and no apparent increase in the risk of hypercalcemia or hyperphosphatemia.
all_evidence.outcome: Key outcomes included CRP, serum albumin, TNF-α, IL-1β, immunoreactive Parathyroid Hormone (iPTH), adverse events, hypercalcemia, and hyperphosphatemia. | In terms of safety, the overall incidence of adverse reactions in the nutritional vitamin D group was similar to that in the control group (P = 0.09). | Moreover, no significant differences were found in the incidence of hypercalcemia and hyperphosphatemia between the two groups (P = 0.15, P = 0.32).
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: Nutritional vitamin D supplementation may improve microinflammation and nutritional status in MHD patients, with potential benefits for bone metabolism and no apparent increase in the risk of hypercalcemia or hyperphosphatemia.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 영양학적 비타민 D 보충은 혈액투석 환자의 미세염증과 영양상태를 개선할 수 있고, 고칼슘혈증이나 고인산혈증 위험을 뚜렷하게 높이지 않으면서 뼈 대사에도 이득이 있을 수 있다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Microinflammation is widespread in Maintenance hemodialysis (MHD) patients. | Nutritional vitamin D deficiency is closely related to chronic kidney disease inflammation, but whether correcting this deficiency can improve microinflammation in the MHD population remains unclear.

all_evidence.title: Efficacy and safety of pharmacological treatments for restless legs syndrome in hemodialysis patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_20: Dopaminergic agents are beneficial but limited by higher adverse event risks, while iron therapy offers moderate benefits with good tolerability.
all_evidence.outcome: The primary outcome was change in International Restless Legs Scale (IRLS) scores; secondary outcomes included sleep quality, quality of life, dialysis adequacy, and adverse events. | Adverse events increased modestly (RR 1.28), highest with dopaminergic agents. | A heatmap further revealed that dopaminergic agents were associated with the highest frequency of adverse events, particularly nausea, hypotension, and augmentation.
all_evidence.key_finding: Dopaminergic agents are beneficial but limited by higher adverse event risks, while iron therapy offers moderate benefits with good tolerability.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 도파민 작용제는 유익하지만 이상반응 위험이 더 높다는 제한이 있고, 철분 치료는 내약성이 양호하면서 중등도 이득을 보였다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Restless Legs Syndrome (RLS) is highly prevalent among adults receiving maintenance hemodialysis and significantly impairs sleep, psychological well-being, and quality of life. | While Western pharmacological treatments such as dopaminergic agents, gabapentinoids, and iron therapy are commonly studied, Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) is also widely used in clinical practice-particularly for syndromes corresponding to RLS such as blood deficiency (Xue Xu), liver-kidney yin deficiency (Gan Shen Bu Zu), and blood stasis (Xue Yu). | However, the evidence base for TCM pharmacologic interventions in hemodialysis-related RLS remains unclear.

all_evidence.title: Efficacy and Safety of Ferric Citrate on Hyperphosphatemia among Chinese Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease Undergoing Hemodialysis: A Phase III Multicenter Randomized Open-Label Active-Drug-Controlled Study.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: Ferric citrate decreased the serum phosphorus level to 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L, comparable to 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L by sevelamer carbonate.
all_evidence.outcome: INTRODUCTION: Hyperphosphatemia in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients is positively associated with mortality. | Frequency and severity of adverse events were recorded. | There are 47 (40.5%) patients in the ferric citrate group, and 26 (21.3%) patients in the sevelamer carbonate group experienced drug-related treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs); most were mild and tolerable.
all_evidence.key_finding: Ferric citrate decreased the serum phosphorus level to 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L, comparable to 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L by sevelamer carbonate.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 구연산철은 혈청 인 수치를 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L로 낮췄고, 세벨라머 탄산염의 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L와 비슷했다.
all_evidence.publication_types: Randomized Controlled Trial|Multicenter Study|Clinical Trial, Phase III|Journal Article|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
all_evidence.population: INTRODUCTION: Hyperphosphatemia in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients is positively associated with mortality. | We compared its efficacy and safety with active drugs in Chinese CKD patients with hemodialysis. | METHODS: Chinese patients undergoing hemodialysis were randomized into two treatment groups in a 1:1 ratio, receiving either ferric citrate or sevelamer carbonate, respectively, for 12 weeks.

all_evidence.title: Add-on astragalus in type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease: A multi-center, assessor-blind, randomized controlled trial.
all_evidence.venue: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: CONCLUSION: In patients with type 2 diabetes, stage 2 to 3 CKD and macroalbuminuria, add-on astragalus for 48 weeks further stabilized kidney function on top of standard care.
all_evidence.outcome: Secondary outcomes included endpoint blood pressures, biochemistry, biomarkers, concomitant drug change and adverse events. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT03535935) RESULTS: During the 48-week period, the estimated difference in the slope of eGFR decline was 4.6 ml/min/1.73m2 per year (95 %CI: 1.5 to 7.6, p = 0.003) slower with astragalus. | 117 adverse events from 31 astragalus-treated patients and 41 standard care-controlled patients were documented.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: In patients with type 2 diabetes, stage 2 to 3 CKD and macroalbuminuria, add-on astragalus for 48 weeks further stabilized kidney function on top of standard care.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 제2형 당뇨병, 2-3기 CKD, 거대알부민뇨 환자에서 48주간 황기를 추가하면 표준치료에 더해 신장기능이 안정화되었다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Diabetes leads to chronic kidney disease (CKD) and kidney failure, requiring dialysis or transplantation. | Astragalus, a common herbal medicine and US pharmacopeia-registered food ingredient, is shown kidney protective by retrospective and preclinical data but with limited long-term prospective clinical evidence. | This trial aimed to assess the effectiveness of astragalus on kidney function decline in macroalbuminuric diabetic CKD patients.

all_evidence.title: Effects of turmeric and curcumin in patients on dialysis or using immunosuppressive agents: a systematic review.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: According to high-quality studies, turmeric and curcumin demonstrated antioxidant and anti-inflammatory benefits in HD patients; however, these compounds did not exhibit a lipid-lowering effect.
all_evidence.outcome: There is an increased risk of oxidative stress and inflammation in hemodialysis (HD) patients, as well as nephrotoxicity in individuals receiving immunosuppressive drugs. | Conversely, a food-drug interaction between immunosuppressive drugs and high doses of turmeric caused nephrotoxicity.
all_evidence.key_finding: According to high-quality studies, turmeric and curcumin demonstrated antioxidant and anti-inflammatory benefits in HD patients; however, these compounds did not exhibit a lipid-lowering effect.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 질 높은 연구에서 강황과 커큐민은 혈액투석 환자에게 항산화·항염 효과를 보였지만 지질 저하 효과는 보이지 않았다.
all_evidence.population: There is an increased risk of oxidative stress and inflammation in hemodialysis (HD) patients, as well as nephrotoxicity in individuals receiving immunosuppressive drugs. | Turmeric (Curcuma longa) and its active compound, curcumin, demonstrate nephroprotective effects through their antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-apoptotic properties. | This article evaluates the effects of turmeric and curcumin as interventions to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation in HD patients and as nephroprotective agents in patients undergoing immunosuppressive therapy.

evidence.title: Chinese herbal medicine (Tangshen Formula) formula treatment of patients with diabetic kidney disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: The results indicate that, compared to the sole conventional placebo treatment, the use of TSF treatment after 24 weeks shows significant improvement in the experimental group over the control group, with UAER (MD=-15.94(95% CI: -30.67-1.22); P=0.03) and 24h UP (MD=-0.20(95% CI:-0.36-0.05);P=0.01); assessment of eGFR and scores showed no significant changes in the levels of these two indicators in patients, e GFR (MD=-4.95(95% CI: -11.52-1.62); P=0.47) and scores (MD=0.35(95% CI: -1.29-1.98);P=0.92).
evidence.outcome: The main outcome indicators included renal Primary Outcomes(UAER, 24h UP), Secondary Outcomes(eGFR and TCM system scores) and adverse events. | In the TMC compound therapy for DKD patients with massive proteinuria, the results show that the probability of adverse experiments in the intervention group was significantly lower than that in the control group (OR= 0.55 95% CI 0.30-1.03), P=0.79).
evidence.key_finding: The results indicate that, compared to the sole conventional placebo treatment, the use of TSF treatment after 24 weeks shows significant improvement in the experimental group over the control group, with UAER (MD=-15.94(95% CI: -30.67-1.22); P=0.03) and 24h UP (MD=-0.20(95% CI:-0.36-0.05);P=0.01); assessment of eGFR and scores showed no significant changes in the levels of these two indicators in patients, e GFR (MD=-4.95(95% CI: -11.52-1.62); P=0.47) and scores (MD=0.35(95% CI: -1.29-1.98);P=0.92).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 24주 후 TSF군은 대조군보다 UAER와 24시간 요단백에서 유의한 개선을 보였지만, eGFR과 점수에는 유의한 변화가 없었다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVE: Diabetic Kidney Disease (DKD) is a severe complication of diabetes mellitus and is one of the main causes of end-stage renal disease globally. | The main outcome indicators included renal Primary Outcomes(UAER, 24h UP), Secondary Outcomes(eGFR and TCM system scores) and adverse events.

evidence.title: Ferric pyrophosphate citrate (Triferic™) administration via the dialysate maintains hemoglobin and iron balance in chronic hemodialysis patients.
evidence.venue: Nephrology, dialysis, transplantation : official publication of the European Dialysis and Transplant Association - European Renal Association
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: RESULTS: In both trials, Hgb concentration was maintained from baseline to EoT in the FPC group but decreased by 0.4 g/dL in the placebo group (P < 0.001, combined results; 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.2-0.6).
evidence.outcome: The proportions of patients with adverse and serious adverse events were similar in both treatment groups.
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: In both trials, Hgb concentration was maintained from baseline to EoT in the FPC group but decreased by 0.4 g/dL in the placebo group (P < 0.001, combined results; 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.2-0.6).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 두 연구 모두 FPC군의 Hgb 농도는 기저치부터 연구 종료 시점까지 유지됐지만 위약군에서는 0.4 g/dL 감소했습니다(P<0.001; 통합 결과 95% 신뢰구간 0.2~0.6).
evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial, Phase III|Journal Article|Multicenter Study|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Administration of ferric pyrophosphate citrate (FPC, Triferic™) via hemodialysate may allow replacement of ongoing uremic and hemodialysis-related iron losses. | METHODS: Two identical Phase 3, randomized, placebo-controlled trials (CRUISE 1 and 2) were conducted in 599 iron-replete chronic hemodialysis patients. | CONCLUSIONS: FPC delivered via dialysate during hemodialysis replaces iron losses, maintains Hgb concentrations, does not increase iron stores and exhibits a safety profile similar to placebo.

evidence.title: Efficacy and Safety of Ferric Citrate on Hyperphosphatemia among Chinese Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease Undergoing Hemodialysis: A Phase III Multicenter Randomized Open-Label Active-Drug-Controlled Study.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: Ferric citrate decreased the serum phosphorus level to 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L, comparable to 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L by sevelamer carbonate.
evidence.outcome: INTRODUCTION: Hyperphosphatemia in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients is positively associated with mortality. | Frequency and severity of adverse events were recorded. | There are 47 (40.5%) patients in the ferric citrate group, and 26 (21.3%) patients in the sevelamer carbonate group experienced drug-related treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs); most were mild and tolerable.
evidence.key_finding: Ferric citrate decreased the serum phosphorus level to 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L, comparable to 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L by sevelamer carbonate.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 구연산철은 혈청 인 수치를 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L로 낮췄고, 세벨라머 탄산염의 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L와 비슷했다.
evidence.publication_types: Randomized Controlled Trial|Multicenter Study|Clinical Trial, Phase III|Journal Article|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
evidence.population: INTRODUCTION: Hyperphosphatemia in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients is positively associated with mortality. | We compared its efficacy and safety with active drugs in Chinese CKD patients with hemodialysis. | METHODS: Chinese patients undergoing hemodialysis were randomized into two treatment groups in a 1:1 ratio, receiving either ferric citrate or sevelamer carbonate, respectively, for 12 weeks.

evidence.title: Add-on astragalus in type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease: A multi-center, assessor-blind, randomized controlled trial.
evidence.venue: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: CONCLUSION: In patients with type 2 diabetes, stage 2 to 3 CKD and macroalbuminuria, add-on astragalus for 48 weeks further stabilized kidney function on top of standard care.
evidence.outcome: Secondary outcomes included endpoint blood pressures, biochemistry, biomarkers, concomitant drug change and adverse events. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT03535935) RESULTS: During the 48-week period, the estimated difference in the slope of eGFR decline was 4.6 ml/min/1.73m2 per year (95 %CI: 1.5 to 7.6, p = 0.003) slower with astragalus. | 117 adverse events from 31 astragalus-treated patients and 41 standard care-controlled patients were documented.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: In patients with type 2 diabetes, stage 2 to 3 CKD and macroalbuminuria, add-on astragalus for 48 weeks further stabilized kidney function on top of standard care.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 제2형 당뇨병, 2-3기 CKD, 거대알부민뇨 환자에서 48주간 황기를 추가하면 표준치료에 더해 신장기능이 안정화되었다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Diabetes leads to chronic kidney disease (CKD) and kidney failure, requiring dialysis or transplantation. | Astragalus, a common herbal medicine and US pharmacopeia-registered food ingredient, is shown kidney protective by retrospective and preclinical data but with limited long-term prospective clinical evidence. | This trial aimed to assess the effectiveness of astragalus on kidney function decline in macroalbuminuric diabetic CKD patients.

evidence.title: Chinese herbal medicine (Tangshen Formula) formula treatment of patients with diabetic kidney disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: The results indicate that, compared to the sole conventional placebo treatment, the use of TSF treatment after 24 weeks shows significant improvement in the experimental group over the control group, with UAER (MD=-15.94(95% CI: -30.67-1.22); P=0.03) and 24h UP (MD=-0.20(95% CI:-0.36-0.05);P=0.01); assessment of eGFR and scores showed no significant changes in the levels of these two indicators in patients, e GFR (MD=-4.95(95% CI: -11.52-1.62); P=0.47) and scores (MD=0.35(95% CI: -1.29-1.98);P=0.92).
evidence.outcome: The main outcome indicators included renal Primary Outcomes(UAER, 24h UP), Secondary Outcomes(eGFR and TCM system scores) and adverse events. | In the TMC compound therapy for DKD patients with massive proteinuria, the results show that the probability of adverse experiments in the intervention group was significantly lower than that in the control group (OR= 0.55 95% CI 0.30-1.03), P=0.79).
evidence.key_finding: The results indicate that, compared to the sole conventional placebo treatment, the use of TSF treatment after 24 weeks shows significant improvement in the experimental group over the control group, with UAER (MD=-15.94(95% CI: -30.67-1.22); P=0.03) and 24h UP (MD=-0.20(95% CI:-0.36-0.05);P=0.01); assessment of eGFR and scores showed no significant changes in the levels of these two indicators in patients, e GFR (MD=-4.95(95% CI: -11.52-1.62); P=0.47) and scores (MD=0.35(95% CI: -1.29-1.98);P=0.92).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 24주 후 TSF군은 대조군보다 UAER와 24시간 요단백에서 유의한 개선을 보였지만, eGFR과 점수에는 유의한 변화가 없었다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVE: Diabetic Kidney Disease (DKD) is a severe complication of diabetes mellitus and is one of the main causes of end-stage renal disease globally. | The main outcome indicators included renal Primary Outcomes(UAER, 24h UP), Secondary Outcomes(eGFR and TCM system scores) and adverse events.

evidence.title: Meta-analysis of Niaoduqing Granules for uremic pruritus in Chinese hemodialysis patients: efficacy and safety evidence from RCTs.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: This meta-analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy favoring the Niaoduqing Granule group (RR = 1.249; 95% CIs = 1.169-1.335; p < 0.001), with safety analyses across three trials revealing comparable adverse event rates (R = 1.303; 95% CIs = 0.589-2.884; p = 0.514; I 2 = 0.0%).
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Uremic pruritus, a common complication in hemodialysis populations, adversely affects quality of life owing to multifactorial etiology. | This meta-analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy favoring the Niaoduqing Granule group (RR = 1.249; 95% CIs = 1.169-1.335; p < 0.001), with safety analyses across three trials revealing comparable adverse event rates (R = 1.303; 95% CIs = 0.589-2.884; p = 0.514; I 2 = 0.0%). | CONCLUSION: Niaoduqing Granules demonstrated efficacy in reducing pruritus severity among hemodialysis patients without increasing drug-related adverse events, while also showing concomitant reductions in inflammatory biomarkers.
evidence.key_finding: This meta-analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy favoring the Niaoduqing Granule group (RR = 1.249; 95% CIs = 1.169-1.335; p < 0.001), with safety analyses across three trials revealing comparable adverse event rates (R = 1.303; 95% CIs = 0.589-2.884; p = 0.514; I 2 = 0.0%).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 이 메타분석에서는 니아오두칭 과립군의 임상적으로 의미 있는 효과가 우세했습니다(RR=1.249, 95% CI 1.169~1.335, p<0.001). 3개 시험의 안전성 분석에서는 이상반응률이 비슷했습니다(R=1.303, 95% CI 0.589~2.884, p=0.514; I²=0.0%).
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Uremic pruritus, a common complication in hemodialysis populations, adversely affects quality of life owing to multifactorial etiology. | To assess its therapeutic potential, a retrospective meta-analysis was performed to evaluate efficacy and safety profiles in hemodialysis cohorts. | We systematically reviewed all available randomized controlled trials (RCTs) investigating the effects of Niaoduqing Granules on uremic pruritus in hemodialysis populations.

evidence.title: Vitamin Profile of the Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease Receiving a Novel Total Parenteral Nutrition Formula: Multicenter Randomized Controlled Phase III Trial.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_6: RESULTS: Values of blood protein until day 8 were similar in 2 groups although those of vitamins B1, B6, C, and folic acid (contained more in OPF-109) were higher in the OPF-109 group.
evidence.outcome: Safety endpoints were hematological data, blood biochemistry data, vital signs, and adverse events.
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: Values of blood protein until day 8 were similar in 2 groups although those of vitamins B1, B6, C, and folic acid (contained more in OPF-109) were higher in the OPF-109 group.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과: 8일까지 혈중 단백질 수치는 두 군이 비슷했지만, 비타민 B1·B6·C와 엽산 수치는 OPF-109군에서 더 높았다.
evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Clinical Trial, Phase III|Multicenter Study|Randomized Controlled Trial
evidence.population:
UNLABELLED:

Introduction: Efficacy and safety of a novel total parenteral nutrition formula for chronic kidney disease patients, OPF-109, containing multivitamins based on the FDA2000 recommendation were investigated. | METHODS: We conducted a phase III clinical trial administering OPF-109 (n = 63) or the control solutions (combination of marketed products including multivitamin based on American Medical Association 1975 guidelines) (n = 61) to the chronic kidney disease patients for 8 days. | CONCLUSION: Efficacy and safety of OPF-109 and usefulness of multivitamins based on the FDA2000 recommendation formula were confirmed in chronic kidney disease patients.

.

all_evidence.title: The role of nutritional vitamin D on microinflammation and nutritional status in maintenance hemodialysis patients: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_15: CONCLUSION: Nutritional vitamin D supplementation may improve microinflammation and nutritional status in MHD patients, with potential benefits for bone metabolism and no apparent increase in the risk of hypercalcemia or hyperphosphatemia.
all_evidence.outcome: Key outcomes included CRP, serum albumin, TNF-α, IL-1β, immunoreactive Parathyroid Hormone (iPTH), adverse events, hypercalcemia, and hyperphosphatemia. | In terms of safety, the overall incidence of adverse reactions in the nutritional vitamin D group was similar to that in the control group (P = 0.09). | Moreover, no significant differences were found in the incidence of hypercalcemia and hyperphosphatemia between the two groups (P = 0.15, P = 0.32).
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: Nutritional vitamin D supplementation may improve microinflammation and nutritional status in MHD patients, with potential benefits for bone metabolism and no apparent increase in the risk of hypercalcemia or hyperphosphatemia.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 영양학적 비타민 D 보충은 혈액투석 환자의 미세염증과 영양상태를 개선할 수 있고, 고칼슘혈증이나 고인산혈증 위험을 뚜렷하게 높이지 않으면서 뼈 대사에도 이득이 있을 수 있다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Microinflammation is widespread in Maintenance hemodialysis (MHD) patients. | Nutritional vitamin D deficiency is closely related to chronic kidney disease inflammation, but whether correcting this deficiency can improve microinflammation in the MHD population remains unclear.

all_evidence.title: Efficacy and safety of pharmacological treatments for restless legs syndrome in hemodialysis patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_20: Dopaminergic agents are beneficial but limited by higher adverse event risks, while iron therapy offers moderate benefits with good tolerability.
all_evidence.outcome: The primary outcome was change in International Restless Legs Scale (IRLS) scores; secondary outcomes included sleep quality, quality of life, dialysis adequacy, and adverse events. | Adverse events increased modestly (RR 1.28), highest with dopaminergic agents. | A heatmap further revealed that dopaminergic agents were associated with the highest frequency of adverse events, particularly nausea, hypotension, and augmentation.
all_evidence.key_finding: Dopaminergic agents are beneficial but limited by higher adverse event risks, while iron therapy offers moderate benefits with good tolerability.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 도파민 작용제는 유익하지만 이상반응 위험이 더 높다는 제한이 있고, 철분 치료는 내약성이 양호하면서 중등도 이득을 보였다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Restless Legs Syndrome (RLS) is highly prevalent among adults receiving maintenance hemodialysis and significantly impairs sleep, psychological well-being, and quality of life. | While Western pharmacological treatments such as dopaminergic agents, gabapentinoids, and iron therapy are commonly studied, Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) is also widely used in clinical practice-particularly for syndromes corresponding to RLS such as blood deficiency (Xue Xu), liver-kidney yin deficiency (Gan Shen Bu Zu), and blood stasis (Xue Yu). | However, the evidence base for TCM pharmacologic interventions in hemodialysis-related RLS remains unclear.

all_evidence.title: Efficacy and Safety of Ferric Citrate on Hyperphosphatemia among Chinese Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease Undergoing Hemodialysis: A Phase III Multicenter Randomized Open-Label Active-Drug-Controlled Study.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: Ferric citrate decreased the serum phosphorus level to 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L, comparable to 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L by sevelamer carbonate.
all_evidence.outcome: INTRODUCTION: Hyperphosphatemia in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients is positively associated with mortality. | Frequency and severity of adverse events were recorded. | There are 47 (40.5%) patients in the ferric citrate group, and 26 (21.3%) patients in the sevelamer carbonate group experienced drug-related treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs); most were mild and tolerable.
all_evidence.key_finding: Ferric citrate decreased the serum phosphorus level to 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L, comparable to 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L by sevelamer carbonate.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 구연산철은 혈청 인 수치를 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L로 낮췄고, 세벨라머 탄산염의 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L와 비슷했다.
all_evidence.publication_types: Randomized Controlled Trial|Multicenter Study|Clinical Trial, Phase III|Journal Article|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
all_evidence.population: INTRODUCTION: Hyperphosphatemia in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients is positively associated with mortality. | We compared its efficacy and safety with active drugs in Chinese CKD patients with hemodialysis. | METHODS: Chinese patients undergoing hemodialysis were randomized into two treatment groups in a 1:1 ratio, receiving either ferric citrate or sevelamer carbonate, respectively, for 12 weeks.

all_evidence.title: Add-on astragalus in type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease: A multi-center, assessor-blind, randomized controlled trial.
all_evidence.venue: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: CONCLUSION: In patients with type 2 diabetes, stage 2 to 3 CKD and macroalbuminuria, add-on astragalus for 48 weeks further stabilized kidney function on top of standard care.
all_evidence.outcome: Secondary outcomes included endpoint blood pressures, biochemistry, biomarkers, concomitant drug change and adverse events. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT03535935) RESULTS: During the 48-week period, the estimated difference in the slope of eGFR decline was 4.6 ml/min/1.73m2 per year (95 %CI: 1.5 to 7.6, p = 0.003) slower with astragalus. | 117 adverse events from 31 astragalus-treated patients and 41 standard care-controlled patients were documented.
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: In patients with type 2 diabetes, stage 2 to 3 CKD and macroalbuminuria, add-on astragalus for 48 weeks further stabilized kidney function on top of standard care.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 제2형 당뇨병, 2-3기 CKD, 거대알부민뇨 환자에서 48주간 황기를 추가하면 표준치료에 더해 신장기능이 안정화되었다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Diabetes leads to chronic kidney disease (CKD) and kidney failure, requiring dialysis or transplantation. | Astragalus, a common herbal medicine and US pharmacopeia-registered food ingredient, is shown kidney protective by retrospective and preclinical data but with limited long-term prospective clinical evidence. | This trial aimed to assess the effectiveness of astragalus on kidney function decline in macroalbuminuric diabetic CKD patients.

all_evidence.title: Effects of turmeric and curcumin in patients on dialysis or using immunosuppressive agents: a systematic review.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: According to high-quality studies, turmeric and curcumin demonstrated antioxidant and anti-inflammatory benefits in HD patients; however, these compounds did not exhibit a lipid-lowering effect.
all_evidence.outcome: There is an increased risk of oxidative stress and inflammation in hemodialysis (HD) patients, as well as nephrotoxicity in individuals receiving immunosuppressive drugs. | Conversely, a food-drug interaction between immunosuppressive drugs and high doses of turmeric caused nephrotoxicity.
all_evidence.key_finding: According to high-quality studies, turmeric and curcumin demonstrated antioxidant and anti-inflammatory benefits in HD patients; however, these compounds did not exhibit a lipid-lowering effect.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 질 높은 연구에서 강황과 커큐민은 혈액투석 환자에게 항산화·항염 효과를 보였지만 지질 저하 효과는 보이지 않았다.
all_evidence.population: There is an increased risk of oxidative stress and inflammation in hemodialysis (HD) patients, as well as nephrotoxicity in individuals receiving immunosuppressive drugs. | Turmeric (Curcuma longa) and its active compound, curcumin, demonstrate nephroprotective effects through their antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-apoptotic properties. | This article evaluates the effects of turmeric and curcumin as interventions to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation in HD patients and as nephroprotective agents in patients undergoing immunosuppressive therapy.

evidence.title: Folic Acid Supplementation and Risk of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review of the Literature.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_4: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과는 엇갈렸지만, 여러 전향적 연구에서 엽산을 매일 800 µg 이상 또는 3~6개월을 초과해 복용하면, 특히 임신 전 시작했을 때 임신성 당뇨병 발생 오즈가 높아질 수 있다고 제시했습니다.
evidence.population: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) affects approximately 14% of pregnancies globally and has been hypothesized to be influenced by periconceptional and early pregnancy folic acid (FA) supplementation, a practice recommended to prevent neural tube defects. | Although current evidence is inconclusive, these results support cautious use of high-dose FA supplementation and the importance of individualized prenatal nutrition, particularly considering B12 status.

evidence.title: Systematic Literature Review and Meta-Analysis of the Relationship Between Polyunsaturated and Trans Fatty Acids During Pregnancy and Offspring Weight Development.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_5: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
evidence.key_finding: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
evidence.key_finding_ko: DHA 및/또는 EPA를 하루 650 mg 초과 보충한 경우 출생체중(MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n=3,831)과 5-10세의 BMI 및 BMI z 점수(SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n=3,220)가 약간 더 높았다.
evidence.population: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis according to PRISMA guidelines to evaluate whether levels of these fatty acids during pregnancy influenced offspring weight development. | Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) with DHA and/or EPA supplementation or cohort studies, which examined levels of DHA, EPA, or TFAs in maternal or neonatal blood samples and recorded offspring weight, were included. | The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).

evidence.title: Benefits and risks of herbal medicine use during pregnancy on offspring outcomes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials and observational studies.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth).
evidence.outcome: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage. | At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth). | Exploratory analyses of individual herbal products suggested that some specific herbs-such as almond oil and Glycyrrhiza (with preterm birth), betel quid (with low birth weight), An-Tai-Yin (with musculoskeletal malformations), khat (with nervous system malformations), and Coptidis Rhizoma (with nervous system and genital organ malformations)-may be linked to increased risks.
evidence.key_finding: At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 전체적으로 교란요인을 보정한 관찰연구에서는 임신 중 허브 사용과 주요 자녀 이상 결과(선천성 기형, 유산, 사산, 조산 포함)의 유의한 연관성이 나타나지 않았다.
evidence.population: PURPOSE: Herbal medicines are widely used during pregnancy, yet their potential effects on offspring remain uncertain. | This systematic review aimed to comprehensively evaluate both the potential benefits and risks of prenatal herbal medicine use on offspring outcomes by synthesizing evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational studies. | Eligible studies reported maternal use of herbal medicines during pregnancy and assessed offspring-related outcomes.

all_evidence.title: DHA Supplementation During Pregnancy Enhances Maternal Vagally Mediated Cardiac Autonomic Control in Humans.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).
all_evidence.outcome: Longitudinal studies examining the potential link between DHA, enhanced vagal tone, and reported reduction in early preterm birth are warranted.
all_evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).

all_evidence.publication_types: Randomized Controlled Trial|Journal Article|Research Support, N.I.H., Extramural
all_evidence.population: OBJECTIVES: The objective of this secondary analysis was to determine if DHA was related to maternal heart rate (HR) and heart rate variability (HRV) metrics in a large cohort of pregnant women. | METHODS: In the parent trial (1R01HD086001) eligible participants (≥18 y old, English speaking, carrying a singleton pregnancy, 12-20 wk of gestation) were randomly assigned to consume 200 mg/d or 800 mg/d DHA for the duration of their pregnancy (n = 300). | Weight, blood pressure, and magnetocardiograms (MCGs) were collected at 32 wk and 36 wk of gestation (n = 221).

all_evidence.title: Nutrition and reproductive potential of women in low- and middle-income countries: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: From RCTs, there was no clear evidence for an effect of prenatal multiple micronutrient supplementation on the risk of miscarriage (8 RCTs; risk ratio (RR): 0.87; 95% CI 0.75, 1.02; moderate certainty of evidence) or stillbirth (15 RCTs; RR: 0.86; 95% CI 0.73, 1.02; low certainty of evidence).
all_evidence.outcome: Outcomes of interest included fertility and fecundity, menarche and menstrual disorders, miscarriage, stillbirth and live birth. | From RCTs, there was no clear evidence for an effect of prenatal multiple micronutrient supplementation on the risk of miscarriage (8 RCTs; risk ratio (RR): 0.87; 95% CI 0.75, 1.02; moderate certainty of evidence) or stillbirth (15 RCTs; RR: 0.86; 95% CI 0.73, 1.02; low certainty of evidence). | From observational cohort studies, preconceptional obesity was associated with a greater risk of miscarriage (12 studies; RR: 1.27; 95% CI 1.10, 1.47; very low certainty of evidence) and stillbirth (4 studies; RR: 1.66; 95% CI 1.28, 2.14; very low certainty of evidence).

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: Maternal alcohol consumption during preconception/pregnancy, maternal intake of vitamin and folic acid during pregnancy, paternal occupational exposure to extremely low-frequency magnetic fields (ELF-MF), and maternal X-ray exposure during pregnancy were also not associated with the risk of NB.
all_evidence.outcome: The objective is to review literature and synthesize risk factors for NB.
all_evidence.key_finding: Maternal alcohol consumption during preconception/pregnancy, maternal intake of vitamin and folic acid during pregnancy, paternal occupational exposure to extremely low-frequency magnetic fields (ELF-MF), and maternal X-ray exposure during pregnancy were also not associated with the risk of NB.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 임신 전·임신 중 모체의 음주, 임신 중 모체의 비타민·엽산 섭취, 부계의 극저주파 자기장 직업 노출, 임신 중 모체의 X선 노출은 신경모세포종 위험과도 연관되지 않았다.
all_evidence.population: We observed associations for maternal occupational exposure to pesticides during preconception/pregnancy (ES 1.62, CI 1.04-2.54), high birthweight [(>4,000 g) ES 1.21, CI 1.02-1.42], and Cesarean section (ES 1.14, CI 1.00-1.30) and the risk of NB. | Parental smoking showed a weak association, while breastfeeding ≥6 months (ES 0.50, CI 0.30-0.84) was inversely associated with NB. | Birth characteristics such as low birthweight (<2,500 g), small and large-for-gestational age, gestation age <37 weeks and gestation age >40 weeks, and assisted reproductive technology were not associated with NB.

all_evidence.title: Maternal exposure to folate antagonists and susceptibility to congenital heart disease in offspring: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: Notably, the protective effect of folic acid supplementation was reported in cases of congenital heart disease linked to dihydrofolate reductase inhibitors but not that associated with antiepileptic drugs.
all_evidence.outcome: AIMS: The objective of this meta-analysis was to determine whether maternal exposure to folate antagonists is associated with increased rates of congenital heart disease in offspring. | RESULTS: Analysis of 6 cohort studies and 5 cross-sectional studies, published between 1976 and 2020, showed significant increase in rate of congenital heart disease (odds ratio 1.55, 95% confidence interval, 1.28-1.87) when exposed to folate antagonists compared with the control. | CONCLUSION: Administration of folate antagonists within the 12-week period preceding conception and throughout the second and third months of gestation exhibited a statistically significant elevation in the susceptibility to congenital heart diseases.
all_evidence.key_finding: Notably, the protective effect of folic acid supplementation was reported in cases of congenital heart disease linked to dihydrofolate reductase inhibitors but not that associated with antiepileptic drugs.

evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_5: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
evidence.key_finding: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).

evidence.title: Benefits and risks of herbal medicine use during pregnancy on offspring outcomes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials and observational studies.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth).
evidence.outcome: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage. | At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth). | Exploratory analyses of individual herbal products suggested that some specific herbs-such as almond oil and Glycyrrhiza (with preterm birth), betel quid (with low birth weight), An-Tai-Yin (with musculoskeletal malformations), khat (with nervous system malformations), and Coptidis Rhizoma (with nervous system and genital organ malformations)-may be linked to increased risks.
evidence.key_finding: At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 전체적으로 교란요인을 보정한 관찰연구에서는 임신 중 허브 사용과 주요 자녀 이상 결과(선천성 기형, 유산, 사산, 조산 포함)의 유의한 연관성이 나타나지 않았다.
evidence.population: PURPOSE: Herbal medicines are widely used during pregnancy, yet their potential effects on offspring remain uncertain. | This systematic review aimed to comprehensively evaluate both the potential benefits and risks of prenatal herbal medicine use on offspring outcomes by synthesizing evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational studies. | Eligible studies reported maternal use of herbal medicines during pregnancy and assessed offspring-related outcomes.

evidence.outcome: Outcomes of interest included fertility and fecundity, menarche and menstrual disorders, miscarriage, stillbirth and live birth. | From RCTs, there was no clear evidence for an effect of prenatal multiple micronutrient supplementation on the risk of miscarriage (8 RCTs; risk ratio (RR): 0.87; 95% CI 0.75, 1.02; moderate certainty of evidence) or stillbirth (15 RCTs; RR: 0.86; 95% CI 0.73, 1.02; low certainty of evidence). | From observational cohort studies, preconceptional obesity was associated with a greater risk of miscarriage (12 studies; RR: 1.27; 95% CI 1.10, 1.47; very low certainty of evidence) and stillbirth (4 studies; RR: 1.66; 95% CI 1.28, 2.14; very low certainty of evidence).
evidence.key_finding: From RCTs, there was no clear evidence for an effect of prenatal multiple micronutrient supplementation on the risk of miscarriage (8 RCTs; risk ratio (RR): 0.87; 95% CI 0.75, 1.02; moderate certainty of evidence) or stillbirth (15 RCTs; RR: 0.86; 95% CI 0.73, 1.02; low certainty of evidence).

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_12: Maternal alcohol consumption during preconception/pregnancy, maternal intake of vitamin and folic acid during pregnancy, paternal occupational exposure to extremely low-frequency magnetic fields (ELF-MF), and maternal X-ray exposure during pregnancy were also not associated with the risk of NB.
all_evidence.outcome: The objective is to review literature and synthesize risk factors for NB.
all_evidence.key_finding: Maternal alcohol consumption during preconception/pregnancy, maternal intake of vitamin and folic acid during pregnancy, paternal occupational exposure to extremely low-frequency magnetic fields (ELF-MF), and maternal X-ray exposure during pregnancy were also not associated with the risk of NB.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 임신 전·임신 중 모체의 음주, 임신 중 모체의 비타민·엽산 섭취, 부계의 극저주파 자기장 직업 노출, 임신 중 모체의 X선 노출은 신경모세포종 위험과도 연관되지 않았다.
all_evidence.population: We observed associations for maternal occupational exposure to pesticides during preconception/pregnancy (ES 1.62, CI 1.04-2.54), high birthweight [(>4,000 g) ES 1.21, CI 1.02-1.42], and Cesarean section (ES 1.14, CI 1.00-1.30) and the risk of NB. | Parental smoking showed a weak association, while breastfeeding ≥6 months (ES 0.50, CI 0.30-0.84) was inversely associated with NB. | Birth characteristics such as low birthweight (<2,500 g), small and large-for-gestational age, gestation age <37 weeks and gestation age >40 weeks, and assisted reproductive technology were not associated with NB.

all_evidence.title: Maternal exposure to folate antagonists and susceptibility to congenital heart disease in offspring: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: Notably, the protective effect of folic acid supplementation was reported in cases of congenital heart disease linked to dihydrofolate reductase inhibitors but not that associated with antiepileptic drugs.
all_evidence.outcome: AIMS: The objective of this meta-analysis was to determine whether maternal exposure to folate antagonists is associated with increased rates of congenital heart disease in offspring. | RESULTS: Analysis of 6 cohort studies and 5 cross-sectional studies, published between 1976 and 2020, showed significant increase in rate of congenital heart disease (odds ratio 1.55, 95% confidence interval, 1.28-1.87) when exposed to folate antagonists compared with the control. | CONCLUSION: Administration of folate antagonists within the 12-week period preceding conception and throughout the second and third months of gestation exhibited a statistically significant elevation in the susceptibility to congenital heart diseases.
all_evidence.key_finding: Notably, the protective effect of folic acid supplementation was reported in cases of congenital heart disease linked to dihydrofolate reductase inhibitors but not that associated with antiepileptic drugs.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 특히 엽산 보충의 보호효과는 디하이드로엽산 환원효소 억제제와 연관된 선천성 심장질환에서 보고됐지만, 항간질약과 연관된 질환에서는 보고되지 않았다.

evidence.title: Folic Acid Supplementation and Risk of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review of the Literature.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_4: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과는 엇갈렸지만, 여러 전향적 연구에서 엽산을 매일 800 µg 이상 또는 3~6개월을 초과해 복용하면, 특히 임신 전 시작했을 때 임신성 당뇨병 발생 오즈가 높아질 수 있다고 제시했습니다.
evidence.population: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) affects approximately 14% of pregnancies globally and has been hypothesized to be influenced by periconceptional and early pregnancy folic acid (FA) supplementation, a practice recommended to prevent neural tube defects. | Although current evidence is inconclusive, these results support cautious use of high-dose FA supplementation and the importance of individualized prenatal nutrition, particularly considering B12 status.

evidence.title: DHA Supplementation During Pregnancy Enhances Maternal Vagally Mediated Cardiac Autonomic Control in Humans.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).
evidence.outcome: Longitudinal studies examining the potential link between DHA, enhanced vagal tone, and reported reduction in early preterm birth are warranted.
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 임신 중 DHA 800 mg/d를 받은 여성은 200 mg/d를 받은 여성보다 심박수와 교감신경 지수가 낮고, 미주신경 매개 심박변이도 지표와 심박변이도 복잡성이 높았습니다(모두 P<0.05).
evidence.publication_types: Randomized Controlled Trial|Journal Article|Research Support, N.I.H., Extramural
evidence.population: OBJECTIVES: The objective of this secondary analysis was to determine if DHA was related to maternal heart rate (HR) and heart rate variability (HRV) metrics in a large cohort of pregnant women. | METHODS: In the parent trial (1R01HD086001) eligible participants (≥18 y old, English speaking, carrying a singleton pregnancy, 12-20 wk of gestation) were randomly assigned to consume 200 mg/d or 800 mg/d DHA for the duration of their pregnancy (n = 300). | Weight, blood pressure, and magnetocardiograms (MCGs) were collected at 32 wk and 36 wk of gestation (n = 221).

evidence.title: Benefits and risks of herbal medicine use during pregnancy on offspring outcomes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials and observational studies.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth).
evidence.outcome: In RCTs, prenatal use of certain herbal medicines was associated the live birth rate (RR=1.14, 95 % CI: 1.05-1.24) and a lower risk of birth defects (RR=0.46, 95 % CI: 0.22-0.94), primarily among women undergoing assisted reproduction; reductions in miscarriage were observed among those with threatened or recurrent miscarriage. | At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth). | Exploratory analyses of individual herbal products suggested that some specific herbs-such as almond oil and Glycyrrhiza (with preterm birth), betel quid (with low birth weight), An-Tai-Yin (with musculoskeletal malformations), khat (with nervous system malformations), and Coptidis Rhizoma (with nervous system and genital organ malformations)-may be linked to increased risks.
evidence.key_finding: At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 전체적으로 교란요인을 보정한 관찰연구에서는 임신 중 허브 사용과 주요 자녀 이상 결과(선천성 기형, 유산, 사산, 조산 포함)의 유의한 연관성이 나타나지 않았다.
evidence.population: PURPOSE: Herbal medicines are widely used during pregnancy, yet their potential effects on offspring remain uncertain. | This systematic review aimed to comprehensively evaluate both the potential benefits and risks of prenatal herbal medicine use on offspring outcomes by synthesizing evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational studies. | Eligible studies reported maternal use of herbal medicines during pregnancy and assessed offspring-related outcomes.

evidence.title: DHA Supplementation During Pregnancy Enhances Maternal Vagally Mediated Cardiac Autonomic Control in Humans.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).
evidence.outcome: Longitudinal studies examining the potential link between DHA, enhanced vagal tone, and reported reduction in early preterm birth are warranted.

evidence.key_finding: From RCTs, there was no clear evidence for an effect of prenatal multiple micronutrient supplementation on the risk of miscarriage (8 RCTs; risk ratio (RR): 0.87; 95% CI 0.75, 1.02; moderate certainty of evidence) or stillbirth (15 RCTs; RR: 0.86; 95% CI 0.73, 1.02; low certainty of evidence).

evidence.title: Folic Acid Supplementation and Risk of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review of the Literature.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_4: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과는 엇갈렸지만, 여러 전향적 연구에서 엽산을 매일 800 µg 이상 또는 3~6개월을 초과해 복용하면, 특히 임신 전 시작했을 때 임신성 당뇨병 발생 오즈가 높아질 수 있다고 제시했습니다.
evidence.population: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) affects approximately 14% of pregnancies globally and has been hypothesized to be influenced by periconceptional and early pregnancy folic acid (FA) supplementation, a practice recommended to prevent neural tube defects. | Although current evidence is inconclusive, these results support cautious use of high-dose FA supplementation and the importance of individualized prenatal nutrition, particularly considering B12 status.

evidence.title: Systematic Literature Review and Meta-Analysis of the Relationship Between Polyunsaturated and Trans Fatty Acids During Pregnancy and Offspring Weight Development.
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_5: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
evidence.key_finding: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
evidence.key_finding_ko: DHA 및/또는 EPA를 하루 650 mg 초과 보충한 경우 출생체중(MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n=3,831)과 5-10세의 BMI 및 BMI z 점수(SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n=3,220)가 약간 더 높았다.
evidence.population: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis according to PRISMA guidelines to evaluate whether levels of these fatty acids during pregnancy influenced offspring weight development. | Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) with DHA and/or EPA supplementation or cohort studies, which examined levels of DHA, EPA, or TFAs in maternal or neonatal blood samples and recorded offspring weight, were included. | The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
